name: Nyanzou & Kumakichi Bomb Cave
description:
Push through the cave where bombs and treasures sleep!
On the floor, the number of bombs around you is written.
Use it as a hint to infer a bomb location and dig it up.
There are many treasures in the cave.
You can sell the treasures you get and create a nice shop.
Also, if you discover the treasure, you will be able to tell you the magic that can be used for search.
Use magic to explore the cave deeper.
